name: Logo cloud
description: A quiet, monochrome strip of stockist or press logos that adds credibility without competing with products.

fields.name: Heading
fields.helpText: A short label rendered as an h2, for example "As featured in".

fields.name: Logos
fields.helpText: 4 to 12. grid looks best with multiples of 4; row with 4 to 6.

fields.name: Logo image
fields.helpText: SVG or transparent PNG. Shown greyscale; the wordmark shows instead when empty.

fields.name: Name
fields.helpText: Used as the image alt text, and as the wordmark fallback when there is no image.

fields.name: Link label
fields.helpText: Studio-only label for the link below; not shown on the page.

fields.name: Link
fields.helpText: Stockist page or article. When set, the logo becomes a link.
